newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real closes steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real closes steady in quiet trade.

text.p: Brazil's real closed flat at 1.0381 against the dollar in calm pre-holiday trading due to dollar inflows in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
In the afternoon the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0380 reais per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market.

Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Friday surplus of $350 million. But dealers believed Friday's surplus would be lower when the day's total contracts were registered.
Dealers said they expect another calm trade session on Monday, the last full trading session before Christmas. On December 24, the market will be open for half the day.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0437 to the dollar, down 0.03 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed steady at 1.130 per greenback.
